# File Format Tags

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/build_reference.py` from `sensoryforge describe --json`. Do not edit: change the code,
then run the command again. -->

The version tag of each file format SensoryForge reads or writes. The [World Engine Contract](world_contract.md) states what the world, data-set and bundle formats guarantee and when their tags change.

This page is generated by `python scripts/build_reference.py`.

| Format | Tag |
|---|---|
| A world file | `sensoryforge-world/1` |
| A data-set file | `sensoryforge-dataset/1` |
| A data bundle without stored voltage probes or a sparse population file | `2.3.0` |
| A data bundle with stored voltage probes | `2.4.0` |
| A data bundle with a sparse population file (it also covers stored voltage probes) | `2.5.0` |
| The description printed by `sensoryforge describe --json` | `sensoryforge-describe/1` |
